cc:Work.dc:description: GOGP99 1999 context. Distinct spatial operators, not two occupations or a 5–30 km range. Stated speeds describe the flow/peak; no exact lateral velocity cutoff is supplied. 30 m reference + 0.09 m/s mean offset; not contemporaneous R13 ADCP widths. Source: Pous, Carton & Lazure (2004), parts 1/2; part2 author-version p6 (PDF7). Fixed width layer, exact occupation, geographic edges and numerical width error unknown. Independent OSW graphic; original copyrighted figures not reproduced.
